_comment: Texture manifest. Every entry is CC0 (public domain, free for commercial use, no attribution required), from ambientCG or Poly Haven, or generated here from a CC0 scan. Run tools/fetch_textures.py to download them. The house is a suburban American centre-hall colonial, and every choice is made for that: see ATTRIBUTION.md for why each scan won and what was rejected.

_fields.scale: real-world size in metres that one tile of the texture covers. Taken from the source's published physical dimensions wherever they exist, so grain, weave and pile all come out at true relative size. Where ambientCG publishes no size, `note` says what the scale was measured from.
_fields.normal_scale: strength of the normal map (1.0 = as authored).
_fields.neutralize: rescale a strongly-coloured albedo to neutral grey so the per-prop tint can recolour it freely, keeping the weave and wear detail. true levels it to 0.72; a number levels it there instead - 0.92 for a slot that replaced a flat colour, so the tint is the colour the prop was designed in.
_fields.dielectric: zero the metallic channel: paint and powder coat over steel are not metal.
_fields.contrast: scale the albedo's variation around its mean (1 = as scanned): for a finish that is more uniform than the scan it was taken from.
_fields.src generated: built by tools/fetch_textures.py from the CC0 scan named in `base`; `recipe` names the builder.
_fields._neutrals: fabrics are deliberately near-greyscale so the per-prop tint can recolour them; tinting an already-coloured scan just muddies it.
_fields.tint: handled in code, not here - one texture serves several colourways.

carpet.note: no published size; pile tufts ~3 mm

osb.note: no published size; OSB strands 5-10 cm

painted_wood.note: satin enamel over MDF is smooth: trim, shaker fronts, painted furniture

worktop_stone.note: no published size; kitchen granite, crystals 3-10 mm

vanity_stone.note: no published size; builder grey-white granite

leather.note: pebble grain calmed toward smooth calf

painted_metal.note: powder coat; orange peel ~2 mm; the scan's mottling read as grime on a white appliance

siding.note: no published size; 8 boards a tile, laid at a 5 in vinyl exposure

roof_shingles.note: 7 courses of 5 5/8 in exposure, measured in plan: 0.143 m x cos 32 deg per course, because world triplanar projects a roof slope mostly from above
